_instructions: This file is a non-executable template only. A future promotion requires: (1) exact candidate source/mirror frozen, (2) QA/build/visual receipts populated, (3) explicit human approval reflected as status=APPROVED, approvedByHuman=true and approvedAt, (4) the approved object copied into release-lock.json pendingReleaseRequest, and (5) Render OS_LIVE_PROMOTION_ENABLED explicitly changed from false to true. After final live+canonical readback, relock by updating currentLive, clearing pendingReleaseRequest, and setting OS_LIVE_PROMOTION_ENABLED=false.
